answer.rationale: Verify the low-cost vendor’s onboarding and invoicing record, and confirm that a second source materially reduces disruption risk. With the line at 94% of committed volume and only 14 days before expiry, a guarded second-source test is safer than abruptly switching primary supply, while creating competitive leverage toward the mandated cost reduction. The archived evidence does not establish that this option alone will deliver the full 18% savings, so cost and capacity effects remain uncertain.
